prompt: Fix the inventory availability calculation in shop/inventory.py. Stock already reserved by other orders should not count as available, and availability must never go below zero. Change the implementation only. The checkout also has tests for nearby behavior.
A promotion can reduce a customer's total below zero. Fix percentage discounts in shop/pricing.py so a discount above 100% is capped and a negative percentage does not raise the subtotal.
A second partial refund can exceed the money remaining on a payment. Fix the refund limit in shop/payments.py while keeping valid partial refunds working.
Support sees orders from the previous day in the daily sales report. Only completed orders on the requested calendar day should contribute. Inspect shop/reporting.py.
Customers with an exact $50 subtotal are charged shipping even though the offer says $50 or more. Fix the boundary in shop/shipping.py.
A warehouse import sometimes records surrounding whitespace on SKU labels. In shop/catalog.py, make lookups ignore surrounding whitespace and letter case on both stored and requested SKUs.

Add support for selecting express shipping at checkout. Add an optional keyword express=False to shop/orders.py checkout and shop/shipping.py shipping_fee. Express costs $12 even above the standard free-shipping threshold. Keep current standard prices and the call signature compatible.

Fix checkout accepting invalid quantities. Both shop/orders.py checkout and shop/pricing.py line_total should reject zero, negative, non-integer and bool quantities with ValueError. Centralize validation in shop/validation.py.

Implement low_stock in shop/inventory.py. Given a sequence of Stock objects and a threshold, return their SKUs in input order when available stock is strictly less than the threshold. Account for reservations and floor availability at zero.

Refactor receipt generation by adding a reusable money formatter format_money(value) in shop/money.py and using it from shop/receipts.py. Preserve the current $ prefix and two-decimal display, and round currency half up.
Add tests/test_quantity_regression.py with a pytest regression test proving that shop/validation.py rejects non-integer quantities, including the string '2'. Keep production behavior unchanged.

Add export_rows to shop/reporting.py. Given an iterable of Order records and a date, return (order_id, rounded Decimal amount) tuples for paid orders on that date, ordered by order ID. Accept generators.
